messages:
alice: FYI starting a config-only deploybot run for prod change window 23:45-00:15 UTC. Adjusting routing weights (route-a -> 85%, route-b -> 15%), reduce default token timeout 5s -> 3s, small batching tweak (max_batch_size 8 -> 6). softpin tenants: tenant-42, tenant-88 to waitlist during canary. deploybot queue id 1729. Please ack and call out any objections.

ben: Acks. Can we confirm kvcache warmup for route-b? last time we saw tail-latency spike on cold starts.

luisa: I ran a preflight on stage earlier — cache warmup script shows ~60% hit after 10m for typical seq length. For route-b the traffic shape is more bursty; suggest enabling prefix caching for the first 30s of canary.

sre-ops: Noted. We'll enable a short drainback window on downstream pods to smooth tail pressure. Also adding circuit condition for rollback: 5xx rate > 0.8% over 2m OR 99th p50 token latency delta > 180ms. If either hits, automatic rollback to previous config.

deploy-bot: deploybot: queued config change (id=1729). Steps: 1) push config to canary (5% global) 2) 10m monitor 3) ramp to 25% if no regressions 4) final ramp to 100% with staggered route shifts. Rollback thresholds as set by sre-ops. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/config-deploybot

mike: Add a note in release notes that this is a non-code config change (limits/timeouts/routing/batching). People using pinned model versions shouldn't be impacted but call it out. Also tagging the private deploy owners for tenant-88.

alice: good call. Release notes snippet: "Config-only: routing weight rebalancing, default token timeout reduced from 5s to 3s, max_batch_size decreased to 6 for improved latency at cost of minor throughput. Softpin applied to tenant-42 & tenant-88 during canary window." Link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/9087654321

ben: Quick checklist before canary: 
- observability dashboards ready (latency, 5xx, queue depth)
- preflight logs attached in the thread
- oncall paged if thresholds trip

luisa: preflight logs:
```
[stage] route-b warmup: kv_hits=62% after 600s
[stage] p95 latency 210ms (baseline 230ms)
```

sre-ops: I'll be standing by for the canary window. If we see increased kv eviction or memory churn, we'll hold ramp and consult infra. Also enabling a thin grace period: if error spike then rather than immediate rollback we drop route-b weight to 0% and hold canary on route-a at 100% while we investigate.

alice: timeline: starting canary push at 23:47 UTC, monitor until 23:57, ramp decision at 23:58. If green, ramp to 25% by 00:05, hold 10m, then finish roll at 00:15.

mike: tagging @tenant-owner-88 to confirm acceptability of softpin.

deploy-bot: config pushed to canary (id=1729) at 23:47:12 UTC. Monitoring hooks active.

ben: Observability: initial 1m looks fine, 5xx ~0.02%, p50 latency down ~12%. continuing to watch.

luisa: No kv eviction spikes yet. prefix caching looked effective during warmup.

sre-ops: At 23:55 we saw a small burst raising 99th token latency by ~40ms but within tolerance. Holding ramp for 2m to observe tail.

alice: holding ramp. If stable at 23:58 we move to 25%. If not, follow the drop-route contingency.

deploy-bot: ramp action delayed by hold flag. Current canary weight 5% -> remaining at 5%.

ben: thumbs up. Good to wait 2m.

mike: Added release-note entry and notified private deploy owners.

sre-ops: 23:58 check: metrics stabilized, no 5xx jump. Proceeding with ramp to 25% now.

deploy-bot: ramped to 25% at 00:00:03 UTC. Continue monitoring for 10m.

luisa: After ramp, p95 latency for route-b rose 15ms but still under SLO. No further kv pressure.

alice: decision: proceed to final ramp at 00:10 if no regressions. Pin fallback version: we will keep previous config snapshot id=1728 available for instant rollback.

sre-ops: Final ramp proceeding. If any PV > threshold we'll do step-down to route-a as previously discussed.

deploy-bot: final ramp to 100% started 00:12:45 UTC, staged in 4 steps to avoid shard thrash.

ben: watching — all green so far. p50 down, error steady.

mike: closing note: post-deploy followup tomorrow morning to validate cost delta due to batching change.

alice: thanks everyone. Marking this thread closed after post-roll checks. :white_check_mark:
